title: No TNO Fantasy Showdown
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a blue demonic sorcerer in ornate robes on the left, a teal armored knight with a glowing sword standing on a rocky platform in the center, and a bandaged mummy holding a staff on the right. In the background a massive golden dragon emerges from a glowing purple portal framed by ancient stone ruins, with a red sun setting over desert dunes and purple flowers lining the path.
prompt: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene at sunset in a desert landscape. On the left stands a blue-skinned demon sorcerer in ornate black and gold robes with horns. In the center a teal armored knight holds a glowing blue sword on a stone platform. On the right a green bandaged mummy with an open mouth holds a staff. A giant golden oriental dragon emerges from a glowing purple portal set in ancient stone ruins behind them, with a red sun and purple flowers visible.
